## About This Document

This in-progress document aims to cover some of the prerequisite terrain to enable genuine engagement with the research document by a motivated reader. The goal is not exhaustive coverage of any area but to provide the minimum working fluency required to follow the argument (and hopefully provide feedback).

It currently addresses probability and information theory. More topics to come.
